segments.text: A language model does not pick the next word directly. It gives every word a score. Then it rolls weighted dice.
Softmax turns the scores into probabilities. Each score becomes a positive number, and together they add up to one.
Temperature divides every score before softmax. At a low temperature, the top word wins almost every time.
At a high temperature, the bars get flat. Rare words get picked more often.
So, low temperature gives focused and repeatable text. High temperature gives varied and surprising text.
